_doc: Optional Acorn Outfitter drop-ins. Save any of these PNGs in this folder and rebuild; the Great Oak draws them instead of the procedural art. Sizes are world units (the world is 600 x 1150); export at 4x for crisp zoom.

custom_pokemon_card.png.use: Giant Framed Pokemon Card on the Outfitter wall (the frame is drawn around it)

custom_film_canister.png.use: One 35mm film canister (stacked into the grain barrel pyramid)

custom_skate_deck.png.use: Skateboard deck, side view, nose to the right (wheels are drawn under it)
